proposals.evidence: CDIAL 6658.1 dvādaśa gives Prakrit bārasa/bāraha, Awadhi/Hindi/Old Marwari bārā, Bhojpuri bārē and Gujarati bār. The initial b- selects the first branch, not duvādaśa (section 2); loss of medial s/h and the final-vowel variants are directly supported.
